===== FILE 0 .github/actions/verify/action.yml =====
name: verify
description: >
  Install the suite's system dependency, then typecheck, test and check the
  package contents. Extracted so `ci` and `release` share one definition:
  the test step below carries a non-obvious workaround, and two copies of it
  is how the release path silently stops matching the path that gates merges.

runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    # Sonata runs every harness inside a tmux session, so the test suite
    # genuinely needs tmux — the fake harness and pane capture depend on it.
    - name: Install tmux
      shell: bash
      run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y tmux

    - shell: bash
      run: npm ci

    - shell: bash
      run: npm run typecheck

    # Every test consistently passes — locally and on every CI attempt — but
    # the vitest process itself sometimes never exits afterward on Linux
    # (worker pinned at ~100% CPU in teardown; root cause not established
    # after profiling, including with --prof). The JSON/JUnit reporters
    # don't help here: their output file is written in vitest's final
    # aggregation step, which is the same step that hangs — confirmed live,
    # a run with every file passing left no results file at all. The
    # 'default' reporter's per-file lines DO stream live (also confirmed:
    # every file's checkmark reliably appears well before the hang), so
    # gate on those instead: bound the step, then check the captured
    # output has one passing checkmark per known test file and no failure
    # marker. A genuine test failure still fails the job; a process that
    # won't exit after everything passed no longer blocks every push.
    - name: Run npm test
      shell: bash
      # The bound and the "carry on regardless" are expressed in the shell
      # rather than as `timeout-minutes` / `continue-on-error`, because a
      # *composite* action's steps accept neither — the runner rejects the
      # whole manifest. Dropping them was not an option: they are what makes
      # this workaround a workaround. Without the bound a hung vitest runs to
      # the job's default timeout (six hours), and without the tolerated exit
      # the kill fails the job the checkmark count exists to judge.
      #
      # --kill-after because the hang is in teardown: the process has already
      # stopped responding to anything polite by the time the bound expires.
      #
      # Written straight to a file, no tee: when stdout is a file, Node's
      # writes are synchronous, so every printed line is durably on disk
      # the moment it appears. Through a pipe the tail gets lost — measured
      # twice: the job-timeout kill terminated `tee` with its final stdio
      # block unflushed, and the last checkmark (always e2e.test.ts, the
      # slowest file) vanished from the capture despite showing live in the
      # Actions UI, failing the count at 46/47.
      run: |
        timeout --kill-after=10s 3m \
          node_modules/.bin/vitest run --reporter=default > /tmp/vitest-output.log 2>&1 || true

    - name: Check test results
      shell: bash
      run: |
        # Strip ANSI color codes first — CI's captured output carries them
        # even though local redirected output doesn't, and they sit between
        # the checkmark glyph and the filename, breaking a plain substring match.
        sed -E 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*[a-zA-Z]//g' /tmp/vitest-output.log > /tmp/vitest-output-plain.log
        cat /tmp/vitest-output-plain.log
        expected=$(find tests -name '*.test.ts' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
        passed=$(/usr/bin/grep -cE '✓ tests/' /tmp/vitest-output-plain.log || true)
        echo "$passed/$expected test files reported passing."
        if /usr/bin/grep -qE '(^ ×| FAIL | ✗)' /tmp/vitest-output-plain.log; then
          echo "A failure marker was found in the output."
          exit 1
        fi
        if [ "$passed" != "$expected" ]; then
          echo "Not every test file reported passing before the run ended."
          exit 1
        fi

    # Catches the packaging mistakes that only appear at publish time:
    # a missing runtime asset, or a bin target excluded by `files`.
    - name: Verify package contents
      shell: bash
      run: |
        npm run build
        npm pack --dry-run --json > /tmp/pack.json
        node -e '
          const files = require("/tmp/pack.json")[0].files.map(f => f.path);
          const required = [
            "dist/cli.js",
            "roles/code.md",
            "roles/review.md",
            "hooks/capture-mode.mjs",
            "ui/index.html",
            "README.md",
            "LICENSE",
          ];
          const missing = required.filter(f => !files.includes(f));
          if (missing.length) {
            console.error("Missing from tarball:", missing.join(", "));
            process.exit(1);
          }
          // A local build stamps dist/build-info.json, and shipping one would
          // make every published install report a "-dev" version.
          if (files.includes("dist/build-info.json")) {
            console.error("Tarball carries dist/build-info.json — a local build stamp must never publish.");
            process.exit(1);
          }
          console.log("Tarball contains all " + required.length + " required files.");
        '

===== FILE 2 .github/workflows/docs.yml =====
name: docs

# Builds docs/ with VitePress and publishes it to GitHub Pages. The site's
# dependencies live in docs/package.json, apart from the CLI's own, so nothing
# here touches the CLI's install, its tests or the published tarball.
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'docs/**'
      - '.github/workflows/docs.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'docs/**'
      - '.github/workflows/docs.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

# One deployment at a time; a newer push supersedes a queued one but never
# cancels a deployment already in progress.
concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          # The site shows each page's last-updated date from git history; a
          # shallow clone would date every page to the deploy commit.
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: docs/package-lock.json

      - run: npm ci
        working-directory: docs

      # A dead link fails the build, so a pull request that breaks one is
      # caught before it reaches the site.
      - run: npm run build
        working-directory: docs

      # Needs the repository's Pages source set to "GitHub Actions"
      # (Settings → Pages); the job token cannot turn Pages on by itself.
      - uses: actions/configure-pages@v5
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'

      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        with:
          path: docs/.vitepress/dist

  deploy:
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pages: write
      id-token: write
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
===== FILE 3 .github/workflows/release.yml =====
name: release

# Fires on the tag `scripts/release.mjs` creates. That script deliberately
# does not push, so publishing is always a separate, deliberate act:
# `git push --follow-tags` is the moment a release becomes public.
on:
  push:
    tags: ['v*']

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      # npm trusted publishing (OIDC) — this is what removes the need for a
      # long-lived NPM_TOKEN in repo secrets. It also backs --provenance.
      id-token: write
      # Creating the GitHub Release.
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          # `contents: write` above makes the job token powerful enough to push.
          # checkout persists it into local git config by default, where every
          # later step — including anything npm runs — can reach it. `gh release
          # create` is handed GH_TOKEN explicitly, so nothing here needs it.
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: npm
          # Required for npm to authenticate against the registry at publish
          # time, OIDC included.
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org'

      # Node 22 bundles npm 10.x, and trusted publishing needs >= 11.5.1 — the
      # runner was measured at node v22.23.2. Without this the OIDC publish
      # fails at the registry rather than in any check above it. Node itself
      # stays on 22 deliberately: that is the version the suite is tested on,
      # and the publishing client is the only part that needs to be newer.
      - name: Ensure npm supports trusted publishing
        run: |
          npm install -g npm@^11.5.1
          npm --version

      # The tag names the version, but package.json is what npm actually
      # publishes. If they disagree, the tag points at one version and the
      # registry receives another — the one failure this scheme cannot
      # self-correct, and it is silent without an explicit check.
      - name: Tag must match package.json
        run: |
          tag="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"
          pkg=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
          if [ "$tag" != "$pkg" ]; then
            echo "Tag $GITHUB_REF_NAME implies version $tag, but package.json says $pkg."
            echo "Re-tag, or fix package.json — do not publish a mismatch."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Publishing version $pkg."

      # Identical to what gates every merge: same suite, same tmux, same
      # tarball-contents check, one definition.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/verify

      # `npm ci` in the composite action installs devDependencies; the build
      # it runs is what `files` ships. Nothing else to do before publishing.
      #
      # Skipped when this exact version is already on the registry, so a rerun
      # after a later step failed does not die on npm's "cannot publish over an
      # existing version" — the publish is the one step in this job that cannot
      # be undone, which makes it the one that most needs to be re-runnable.
      - name: Publish to npm
        run: |
          name=$(node -p "require('./package.json').name")
          version=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
          # `npm view` exits non-zero for "does not exist" AND for a network,
          # auth or rate-limit failure, so the exit code alone cannot decide
          # this. Only a confirmed E404 means "not published yet"; anything
          # else is an unanswered question, and guessing on it is how a
          # transient blip turns back into the confusing duplicate-version
          # error this guard exists to prevent.
          set +e
          out=$(npm view "$name@$version" version 2>&1)
          rc=$?
          set -e
          if [ $rc -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "$name@$version is already on the registry — skipping publish."
          elif printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q 'E404'; then
            npm publish --access public --provenance
          else
            echo "Could not determine whether $name@$version is published:"
            printf '%s\n' "$out"
            exit 1
          fi

      # The body is this version's CHANGELOG section, so the release notes and
      # the changelog cannot drift — there is only one place they are written.
      # Extraction lives in the script, where it is tested, rather than inline
      # in YAML where it would be neither reviewed nor run before a release.
      - name: Extract release notes
        run: |
          node scripts/release.mjs --notes "${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}" > /tmp/notes.md
          echo "Extracted $(wc -l < /tmp/notes.md) lines of notes."

      # Same rerun reasoning as the publish step: `gh release create` fails on a
      # tag that already has a release, which would leave a rerun red after the
      # work it was rerun to finish had actually succeeded.
      - name: Create GitHub Release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          # Same fail-closed reasoning as the publish step: `gh release view`
          # exits non-zero for a missing release and for a failed lookup alike.
          set +e
          out=$(gh release view "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" 2>&1)
          rc=$?
          set -e
          if [ $rc -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "Release $GITHUB_REF_NAME already exists — skipping."
          elif printf '%s' "$out" | grep -qi 'release not found'; then
            gh release create "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" --title "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" --notes-file /tmp/notes.md
          else
            echo "Could not determine whether release $GITHUB_REF_NAME exists:"
            printf '%s\n' "$out"
            exit 1
          fi

===== FILE 9 scripts/bench-router-ledger.ts =====
/**
 * Timing harness for the router's ledger-dependent paths.
 *
 * Builds a synthetic ledger (default ~92k rows over 30 days, ~55 MB) in a
 * private temp home — it never touches the real home or `~/.config/sonata` —
 * and times what a busy router pays: the per-request `[budget]` check, and the
 * console endpoints the dashboard polls.
 *
 *   npx tsx scripts/bench-router-ledger.ts [--rows=92000] [--reps=15] [--keep]
 *
 * Run with `node --expose-gc --import tsx scripts/bench-router-ledger.ts` to
 * also get a settled RSS figure for the shared snapshot.
 */
import { mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join, dirname } from 'node:path';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';

import { spentTodayUsd, unreadableMachineBudget } from '../src/budget.js';
import { loadConfig } from '../src/config.js';
import { ledgerDir } from '../src/ledger.js';
import { handleUiRequest, clearHostConfigCache, type UiDeps } from '../src/native/ui.js';

const arg = (name: string, fallback: number): number => {
  const hit = process.argv.find((a) => a.startsWith(`--${name}=`));
  return hit === undefined ? fallback : Number(hit.slice(name.length + 3));
};
const ROWS = arg('rows', 92_000);
const REPS = arg('reps', 15);
const DAY = 86_400_000;

export const CONFIG = [
  'schema_version = 2',
  '[budget]',
  'daily_usd = 100000',
  '[native.gateways."opencode-go-primary"]',
  'base_url = "https://opencode.ai/inference/go/v1"',
  'plan = "go-plus"',
  '[native.gateways."opencode-go-ucha1"]',
  'base_url = "https://opencode.ai/inference/go/v1"',
  'plan = "go-plus"',
  '[models."spark"]',
  'gateway = "opencode-go-primary"',
  'id = "muse-spark-1.3-contributor"',
  'context_window = 128000',
  '[models."spark-u1"]',
  'gateway = "opencode-go-ucha1"',
  'id = "muse-spark-1.3-contributor"',
  'context_window = 128000',
  '[tiers."code"]',
  'simple = ["spark@xhigh", "spark-u1@xhigh"]',
  'normal = ["spark@xhigh", "spark-u1@xhigh"]',
  'complex = ["spark@max", "spark-u1@max"]',
  '[tiers."review"]',
  'simple = ["spark@xhigh", "spark-u1@xhigh"]',
  'normal = ["spark@xhigh", "spark-u1@xhigh"]',
  'complex = ["spark@max", "spark-u1@max"]',
].join('\n');

function rng(seed: number): () => number {
  let s = seed >>> 0;
  return () => { s = (Math.imul(s, 1664525) + 1013904223) >>> 0; return s / 2 ** 32; };
}

/** ~600-byte rows shaped like the router's own. */
export function makeLedger(home: string, rows: number, now: number): { tenants: string[]; bytes: number } {
  const dir = ledgerDir(home);
  mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  const rand = rng(42);
  const tenants = ['t-aaaaaaaa', 't-bbbbbbbb', 't-cccccccc'];
  const gateways = ['opencode-go-primary', 'opencode-go-ucha1'];
  const roles = ['code', 'review'];
  const tiers = ['simple', 'normal', 'complex'];
  const byDay = new Map<string, string[]>();
  // Skew: the newest day carries ~16% of the volume, like a busy day.
  for (let i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
    const today = rand() < 0.16;
    const ts = today
      ? now - Math.floor(rand() * ((now % DAY) || DAY))
      : now - Math.floor(rand() * 29 * DAY) - (now % DAY) - 1;
    const iso = new Date(ts).toISOString();
    const gateway = gateways[Math.floor(rand() * 2)]!;
    const role = roles[Math.floor(rand() * 2)]!;
    const tier = tiers[Math.floor(rand() * 3)]!;
    const failed = rand() < 0.04;
    const row = {
      ts: iso, ms: Math.floor(rand() * 20000), session: `sess-${Math.floor(rand() * 600)}`,
      project: `/home/u/dev/proj${Math.floor(rand() * 6)}`, tenant: tenants[Math.floor(rand() * 3)],
      alias: `sonata-${role}-${tier}`, role, tier, route: rand() < 0.5 ? 'auto' : 'manual',
      key: gateway === 'opencode-go-primary' ? 'spark' : 'spark-u1', effort: rand() < 0.5 ? 'xhigh' : 'max',
      gateway, upstream: 'litellm', litellmModel: 'openai/muse-spark-1.3-contributor',
      callId: `call_${Math.floor(rand() * 1e12).toString(36)}${i.toString(36)}`,
      status: failed ? 429 : 200, complete: !failed,
      ...(failed ? { error: 'rate limit reached for this window, retry later (limitName: weekly)' } : {}),
      tokens: {
        input: Math.floor(rand() * 40000), output: Math.floor(rand() * 4000),
        cacheRead: Math.floor(rand() * 90000), cacheCreation: Math.floor(rand() * 3000),
      },
      price: rand() < 0.1 ? { source: 'none' } : { source: 'models-dev', totalUsd: rand() * 0.05, observedAt: iso },
      attempts: failed ? [{ key: 'spark@xhigh', status: 429 }, { key: 'spark-u1@xhigh', status: 200 }] : [{ key: 'spark@xhigh', status: 200 }],
      litellm: { fallbacks: 0, retries: 0 },
    };
    const day = iso.slice(0, 10);
    let list = byDay.get(day);
    if (list === undefined) { list = []; byDay.set(day, list); }
    list.push(JSON.stringify(row));
  }
  let bytes = 0;
  for (const [day, lines] of byDay) {
    lines.sort(); // `ts` is the first key, so this is chronological
    const text = `${lines.join('\n')}\n`;
    bytes += text.length;
    writeFileSync(join(dir, `${day}.jsonl`), text);
  }
  return { tenants, bytes };
}

const median = (xs: number[]): number => [...xs].sort((a, b) => a - b)[Math.floor(xs.length / 2)]!;
interface Timing { first: number; med: number; min: number; cpuMed: number }
/**
 * Wall time and CPU time per call. The box is shared with other agents, so
 * wall time inflates with load; CPU time (user + system of this process) is
 * the steadier figure and is what the "pegged a core" symptom is about.
 */
async function time(fn: () => unknown | Promise<unknown>, reps = REPS): Promise<Timing> {
  const ts: number[] = [];
  const cpu: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < reps; i++) {
    const c0 = process.cpuUsage();
    const t0 = performance.now();
    await fn();
    ts.push(performance.now() - t0);
    const c = process.cpuUsage(c0);
    cpu.push((c.user + c.system) / 1000);
  }
  return { first: ts[0]!, med: median(ts), min: Math.min(...ts), cpuMed: median(cpu) };
}
const fmt = (t: Timing): string =>
  `wall first ${t.first.toFixed(2)} / median ${t.med.toFixed(2)} / min ${t.min.toFixed(2)} ms   cpu median ${t.cpuMed.toFixed(2)} ms`;
const mb = (n: number): string => `${(n / 1048576).toFixed(0)} MB`;

async function main(): Promise<void> {
  const root = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'sonata-bench-'));
  const home = join(root, 'home');
  mkdirSync(join(home, '.config', 'sonata'), { recursive: true });
  writeFileSync(join(home, '.config', 'sonata', 'sonata.toml'), CONFIG);
  const now = Date.now();
  const { tenants, bytes } = makeLedger(home, ROWS, now);
  process.env.HOME = home;
  console.log(`load average ${(await import('node:os')).loadavg().map((n) => n.toFixed(1)).join(' ')} on ${(await import('node:os')).cpus().length} cpus`);
  console.log(`ledger: ${ROWS} rows, ${mb(bytes)}, home ${home}`);

  // The per-request budget check, as `cmdServe` wired it before the snapshot.
  const machineRaw = join(home, '.config', 'sonata', 'sonata.toml');
  const legacyBudget = (): unknown => {
    const cfg = loadConfig(dirname(machineRaw), home);
    return [
      spentTodayUsd(home, Date.now(), { tenant: tenants[0] }),
      spentTodayUsd(home),
      cfg.budget?.dailyUsd,
      unreadableMachineBudget(home),
    ];
  };
  const before = !process.argv.includes('--no-before');
  if (before) {
    console.log('\n[budget] per routed request, legacy path (2 spentTodayUsd + loadConfig + unreadableMachineBudget)');
    console.log(`  ${fmt(await time(legacyBudget))}`);
  }

  const hostHeader = { host: 'localhost:4100' };
  const get = async (deps: UiDeps, url: string): Promise<number> => {
    const res = await handleUiRequest({ method: 'GET', url, headers: hostHeader }, deps);
    if (res === undefined) throw new Error('unclaimed');
    const r = await res;
    if (r.status !== 200) throw new Error(`${url} -> ${r.status}`);
    return (r.body as Buffer).length;
  };
  const endpoints = ['console', 'limits', 'ladders', 'verdict', 'feed'];
  const run = async (label: string, deps: UiDeps): Promise<void> => {
    console.log(`\n[console endpoints] ${label}`);
    for (const e of endpoints) {
      clearHostConfigCache();
      let size = 0;
      const t = await time(async () => { size = await get(deps, `/__sonata/api/${e}`); }, Math.min(REPS, 8));
      console.log(`  ${e.padEnd(8)} ${fmt(t)}   (${size} bytes)`);
    }
  };
  if (before) await run('no shared snapshot (every call re-reads the ledger)', { home, port: 4100 });

  if (!process.argv.includes('--no-after')) {
    const { createLedgerSnapshot } = await import('../src/ledger-snapshot.js');
    const { createMachineConfigCache } = await import('../src/machine-config-cache.js');
    const gc = (globalThis as { gc?: () => void }).gc;
    gc?.();
    const rss0 = process.memoryUsage();
    const ledger = createLedgerSnapshot(home);
    const t0 = performance.now();
    const c0 = process.cpuUsage();
    await ledger.warm();
    const c = process.cpuUsage(c0);
    console.log(`\n[snapshot] cold load: wall ${(performance.now() - t0).toFixed(0)} ms, cpu ${((c.user + c.system) / 1000).toFixed(0)} ms, ${JSON.stringify(ledger.stats())}`);
    gc?.();
    const rss1 = process.memoryUsage();
    console.log(`[snapshot] memory after load: rss ${mb(rss1.rss)} (was ${mb(rss0.rss)}), heapUsed ${mb(rss1.heapUsed)} (was ${mb(rss0.heapUsed)})  -> +${mb(rss1.heapUsed - rss0.heapUsed)} heap for ${ROWS} rows`);

    const cache = createMachineConfigCache(home);
    const newBudget = (): unknown => [
      ledger.spentToday(Date.now(), { tenant: tenants[0] }) ?? spentTodayUsd(home, Date.now(), { tenant: tenants[0] }),
      ledger.spentToday(Date.now()) ?? spentTodayUsd(home),
      cache.config()?.budget?.dailyUsd,
      cache.unreadable(),
    ];
    console.log('\n[budget] per routed request, snapshot path (2 spentToday + cached config + cached unreadableMachineBudget)');
    console.log(`  ${fmt(await time(newBudget, 2000))}`);
    // The same, with a row appended in-process before each check (a busy router).
    const { appendRow } = await import('../src/ledger.js');
    let n = 0;
    const withAppend = (): unknown => {
      const ts = new Date().toISOString();
      appendRow(home, {
        ts, ms: 1, alias: 'sonata-code-normal', key: 'spark', gateway: 'opencode-go-primary', upstream: 'litellm', status: 200,
        complete: true, tenant: tenants[0], tokens: { input: 1, output: 1, cacheRead: 0, cacheCreation: 0 },
        price: { source: 'models-dev', totalUsd: 0.001 }, attempts: [], callId: `bench-${n++}`,
      });
      ledger.noteAppended(ts);
      return newBudget();
    };
    console.log('  with one in-process append + noteAppended before each check (append itself included):');
    console.log(`  ${fmt(await time(withAppend, 500))}`);

    await run('shared snapshot, memo off (fresh `now` each call defeats the memo key)', { home, port: 4100, ledger, now: () => Date.now() });
    await run('shared snapshot + 5 s payload memo', { home, port: 4100, ledger });
    gc?.();
    const rss2 = process.memoryUsage();
    console.log(`\n[snapshot] after endpoint polling: rss ${mb(rss2.rss)}, heapUsed ${mb(rss2.heapUsed)}`);
  }
  rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
}

if (process.argv[1] !== undefined && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href) {
  main().catch((e) => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); });
}

import { test, expect } from 'claude-code/testing'
import { panelTree, type PanelData } from './panel'
import type { AgentRow, Loop, RouteLine } from '../types'

// Render panelTree to plain rows: one string per line, with the colour of
// each run kept beside it so a test can ask what a span was drawn in.
type N = { type: string; props: any; children: any[] }
const h = (type: any, props: any, ...children: any[]): N => ({ type, props: props ?? {}, children: children.flat(Infinity) })
const els = { Box: 'Box', Text: 'Text', Button: 'Button' }
function rows(tree: N): string[] {
  const out: string[] = []
  const text = (n: any): string => (n == null || n === false || n === true ? '' : typeof n === 'object' ? n.children.map(text).join('') : String(n))
  const walk = (n: any) => {
    if (n == null || n === false || n === true || n === '') return
    if (n.type === 'Box' && n.props.flexDirection !== 'row') { if (n.props.height === 0) return; n.children.forEach(walk); return }
    out.push(text(n))
  }
  walk(tree)
  return out
}
const colorOf = (tree: N, needle: string): string | undefined => {
  let found: string | undefined
  const walk = (n: any, c?: string) => {
    if (n == null || typeof n !== 'object') { if (typeof n === 'string' && n.includes(needle) && found === undefined) found = c; return }
    n.children.forEach((k: any) => walk(k, n.props?.color ?? c))
  }
  walk(tree)
  return found
}
const noop = { select() {}, toggleFold() {}, toggleActive() {}, jumpLatest() {}, copy() {} }

const NOW = 1_000_000
const agent = (o: Partial<AgentRow> & Pick<AgentRow, 'id' | 'type'>): AgentRow =>
  ({ description: 'd', taskId: '1', status: 'running', steps: 3, stepTimes: [], usedBash: false, hunks: [], startedAt: NOW - 60_000, ...o })
const loop = (agentIds: string[], extra: Partial<Loop['tasks'][0]> = {}): Loop =>
  ({ title: 't', startedAt: NOW - 60_000, isDone: false, tasks: [{ id: '1', title: 'Task one', state: 'coding', failures: 0, agentIds, ...extra }, { id: '2', title: 'Task two', state: 'pending', failures: 0, agentIds: [] }] })
const data = (o: Partial<PanelData>): PanelData =>
  ({ loop: null, agents: [], router: { routes: [], at: NOW - 1000 }, view: { showAll: true, expanded: [] }, now: NOW, cols: 72, ...o })
const draw = (d: PanelData) => panelTree(h, els, d, noop) as N

})

import { test, expect } from 'claude-code/testing'
import { applyLoopAction, isSonataAgent } from './model'
import type { Loop } from '../types'

const planned = (): Loop => {
  const r = applyLoopAction(null, { action: 'plan', title: 'auth', tasks: [{ id: '1', title: 'A' }, { id: '2', title: 'B' }] }, 0)
  if ('error' in r || r.loop === null) throw new Error('plan failed')
  return r.loop
}
const ok = (r: ReturnType<typeof applyLoopAction>): Loop => {
  if ('error' in r) throw new Error(r.error)
  return r.loop!
}

test('plan creates pending tasks', () => {
  expect(planned().tasks.map(t => t.state)).toEqual(['pending', 'pending'])
})

test('start, failing result, fix, passing result', () => {
  let loop = ok(applyLoopAction(planned(), { action: 'start', taskId: '1', phase: 'code' }, 1))
  expect(loop.tasks[0].state).toBe('coding')
  expect(loop.pendingTaskId).toBe('1')
  loop = ok(applyLoopAction(loop, { action: 'start', taskId: '1', phase: 'review' }, 2))
  loop = ok(applyLoopAction(loop, { action: 'result', taskId: '1', outcome: 'fail' }, 3))
  expect(loop.tasks[0]).toMatchObject({ failures: 1, openPhase: undefined })
  loop = ok(applyLoopAction(loop, { action: 'start', taskId: '1', phase: 'fix' }, 4))
  expect(loop.tasks[0].state).toBe('fixing')
  loop = ok(applyLoopAction(loop, { action: 'start', taskId: '1', phase: 'review' }, 5))
  loop = ok(applyLoopAction(loop, { action: 'result', taskId: '1', outcome: 'pass' }, 6))
  expect(loop.tasks[0].state).toBe('done')
})

test('a second start without a result replaces the open phase', () => {
  let loop = ok(applyLoopAction(planned(), { action: 'start', taskId: '1', phase: 'review' }, 1))
  loop = ok(applyLoopAction(loop, { action: 'start', taskId: '1', phase: 'fix' }, 2))
  expect(loop.tasks[0]).toMatchObject({ state: 'fixing', openPhase: 'fix' })
})

test('escalate and done', () => {
  let loop = ok(applyLoopAction(planned(), { action: 'escalate', taskId: '2', to: 'complex' }, 1))
  expect(loop.tasks[1].escalatedTo).toBe('complex')
  loop = ok(applyLoopAction(loop, { action: 'done', summary: 'shipped' }, 2))
  expect(loop).toMatchObject({ isDone: true, summary: 'shipped' })
})

test('validation errors', () => {
  const loop = planned()
  expect(applyLoopAction(loop, { action: 'start', taskId: '9', phase: 'code' }, 1)).toEqual({ error: 'unknown taskId "9"; the plan has 1, 2' })
  expect(applyLoopAction(loop, { action: 'result', taskId: '1', outcome: 'pass' }, 1)).toEqual({ error: 'result for task "1" with no start before it' })
  expect(applyLoopAction(loop, { action: 'plan', title: 'x', tasks: [] }, 1)).toEqual({ error: 'a loop is already running; call done first' })
  expect(applyLoopAction(null, { action: 'start', taskId: '1', phase: 'code' }, 1)).toEqual({ error: 'no loop: call plan first' })
  expect(applyLoopAction(loop, { action: 'jump' }, 1)).toEqual({ error: 'unknown action "jump"; expected plan, start, result, escalate or done' })
  expect(applyLoopAction(loop, { action: 'start', taskId: '1', phase: 'deploy' }, 1)).toEqual({ error: 'phase must be code, fix, review or final' })
  expect(applyLoopAction(null, { action: 'plan', title: 'x', tasks: [{ id: '1', title: 'a' }, { id: '1', title: 'b' }] }, 1)).toEqual({ error: 'duplicate task id "1"' })
})

  let loop = ok(applyLoopAction(planned(), { action: 'start', taskId: '1', phase: 'review' }, 1))
  loop = ok(applyLoopAction(loop, { action: 'result', taskId: '1', outcome: 'pass' }, 2))

  loop = ok(applyLoopAction(loop, { action: 'start', taskId: '2', phase: 'review' }, 5))
  loop = ok(applyLoopAction(loop, { action: 'result', taskId: '1', outcome: 'fail' }, 6))
  expect(loop.pendingTaskId).toBe('2')

===== FILE 15 skills/loop/hooks/model.ts =====
import type { AgentRow, Hunk, Loop, LoopTask, Phase, RouteLine, Tier } from '../types'

const SONATA_AGENT = /^(native-)?(code|review|explore|plan)(-|$)/
export const isSonataAgent = (type: string): boolean => SONATA_AGENT.test(type)

const PHASES: readonly Phase[] = ['code', 'fix', 'review', 'final']
const TIERS: readonly Tier[] = ['simple', 'normal', 'complex']
const STATE_FOR: Record<Phase, LoopTask['state']> = { code: 'coding', fix: 'fixing', review: 'review', final: 'review' }

type Result = { loop: Loop | null } | { error: string }
const str = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v !== ''

export function applyLoopAction(loop: Loop | null, input: unknown, now: number): Result {
  const a = (input ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>
  if (a.action === 'plan') {
    if (loop !== null && !loop.isDone) return { error: 'a loop is already running; call done first' }
    if (!str(a.title) || !Array.isArray(a.tasks)) return { error: 'plan needs title and tasks: [{ id, title }]' }
    const seen = new Set<string>()
    const tasks: LoopTask[] = []
    for (const t of a.tasks as Record<string, unknown>[]) {
      if (!str(t?.id) || !str(t?.title)) return { error: 'each task needs a string id and title' }
      if (seen.has(t.id)) return { error: `duplicate task id "${t.id}"` }
      seen.add(t.id)
      tasks.push({ id: t.id, title: t.title, state: 'pending', failures: 0, agentIds: [] })
    }
    return { loop: { title: a.title, tasks, isDone: false, startedAt: now } }
  }
  if (!['start', 'result', 'escalate', 'done'].includes(String(a.action))) {
    return { error: `unknown action "${String(a.action)}"; expected plan, start, result, escalate or done` }
  }
  if (loop === null || loop.isDone) return { error: 'no loop: call plan first' }
  if (a.action === 'done') return { loop: { ...loop, isDone: true, summary: str(a.summary) ? a.summary : undefined, pendingTaskId: undefined } }

  const task = loop.tasks.find(t => t.id === a.taskId)
  if (task === undefined) return { error: `unknown taskId "${String(a.taskId)}"; the plan has ${loop.tasks.map(t => t.id).join(', ')}` }
  const put = (next: LoopTask, extra: Partial<Loop> = {}): Result =>
    ({ loop: { ...loop, ...extra, tasks: loop.tasks.map(t => (t.id === next.id ? next : t)) } })

  if (a.action === 'start') {
    if (!PHASES.includes(a.phase as Phase)) return { error: 'phase must be code, fix, review or final' }
    const phase = a.phase as Phase
    return put({ ...task, state: STATE_FOR[phase], openPhase: phase }, { pendingTaskId: task.id })
  }
  if (a.action === 'result') {
    if (task.openPhase === undefined) return { error: `result for task "${task.id}" with no start before it` }
    if (a.outcome !== 'pass' && a.outcome !== 'fail') return { error: 'outcome must be pass or fail' }
    // A dispatch that never happened must not leave its task waiting to
    // claim the next, unrelated spawn; another task's pending start stays.
    const clear: Partial<Loop> = loop.pendingTaskId === task.id ? { pendingTaskId: undefined } : {}
    if (a.outcome === 'fail') return put({ ...task, failures: task.failures + 1, openPhase: undefined }, clear)
    const isReview = task.openPhase === 'review' || task.openPhase === 'final'
    return put({ ...task, state: isReview ? 'done' : task.state, openPhase: undefined }, clear)
  }
  if (!TIERS.includes(a.to as Tier)) return { error: 'to must be simple, normal or complex' }
  return put({ ...task, escalatedTo: a.to as Tier })
}

type Tracked = { loop: Loop | null; agents: AgentRow[] }

export function spawnAgent(
  s: Tracked,
  e: { agentId: string; subagentType: string; description: string; parentAgentId?: string },
  now: number,
): Tracked {
  if (!isSonataAgent(e.subagentType)) return s
  const parent = e.parentAgentId === undefined ? undefined : s.agents.find(a => a.id === e.parentAgentId)
  // A child belongs to its tracked parent's task. Without one (no parent, or a
  // parent that is not a sonata agent) it is top-level and takes the pending task.
  const parentId = parent?.id
  const taskId = parent !== undefined ? parent.taskId : s.loop?.pendingTaskId
  const row: AgentRow = {
    id: e.agentId, type: e.subagentType, description: e.description, parentId,
    taskId, status: 'running', steps: 0, stepTimes: [], usedBash: false, hunks: [], startedAt: now,
  }
  let loop = s.loop
  if (loop !== null && taskId !== undefined) {
    loop = {
      ...loop,
      pendingTaskId: parent === undefined ? undefined : loop.pendingTaskId,
      tasks: loop.tasks.map(t => (t.id === taskId ? { ...t, agentIds: [...t.agentIds, e.agentId] } : t)),
    }
  }
  return { loop, agents: [...s.agents, row] }
}

const patch = (agents: AgentRow[], id: string, fn: (a: AgentRow) => AgentRow): AgentRow[] =>
  agents.some(a => a.id === id) ? agents.map(a => (a.id === id ? fn(a) : a)) : agents

/**
 * The router alias a step's model names. Claude Code appends a context-window
 * marker (`sonata-explore-simple[1m]`, measured 2026-10-09) that the router's
 * ledger never carries, so an exact comparison matched no route at all.
 */
export const routerAlias = (model: string): string => model.replace(/\[[^\]]*\]$/, '')

export const stepAgent = (agents: AgentRow[], e: { agentId: string; model: string }, now: number): AgentRow[] =>
  patch(agents, e.agentId, a => ({ ...a, steps: a.steps + 1, alias: routerAlias(e.model), stepTimes: [...a.stepTimes, now].slice(-200) }))

const base = (p: string): string => p.split('/').pop() ?? p

function describeCall(tool: string, input: Record<string, unknown>): string {
  const s = (k: string): string | undefined => (typeof input[k] === 'string' ? (input[k] as string) : undefined)
  const target = s('file_path') ? base(s('file_path')!)
    : s('pattern') ?? s('path') ?? (s('command')?.trim().split(/\s+/)[0]) ?? s('description')
  return target === undefined ? tool : `${tool} ${target}`
}

export const toolActivity = (agents: AgentRow[], e: { agentId: string; tool: string; input: Record<string, unknown> }): AgentRow[] =>
  patch(agents, e.agentId, a => ({ ...a, activity: describeCall(e.tool, e.input), usedBash: a.usedBash || e.tool === 'Bash' }))

export const completeAgent = (agents: AgentRow[], e: { agentId: string; reason: 'answer' | 'aborted' | 'refusal' | 'error' }, now: number): AgentRow[] =>
  patch(agents, e.agentId, a => ({
    ...a, activity: undefined, endedAt: now,
    status: e.reason === 'answer' ? 'done' : e.reason === 'aborted' ? 'aborted' : 'error',
  }))

export const childrenOf = (agents: AgentRow[], id: string | undefined): AgentRow[] =>
  agents.filter(a => a.parentId === id)

export function depthOf(agents: AgentRow[], id: string): number {
  let depth = 0
  let cur = agents.find(a => a.id === id)
  while (cur?.parentId !== undefined && depth < 32) {
    cur = agents.find(a => a.id === cur!.parentId)
    if (cur === undefined) break
    depth++
  }
  return depth
}

export const HUNK_LINES = 40
export const MAX_HUNKS = 30

function capped(file: string, removed: string[], added: string[], isNewFile: boolean): Hunk {
  // Removed lines first; added lines get the rest of the budget, or the whole
  // budget when removed used it all, so a big replacement still shows its new side.
  const keepRemoved = removed.slice(0, HUNK_LINES)
  const keepAdded = added.slice(0, Math.max(0, HUNK_LINES - keepRemoved.length) || HUNK_LINES)
  const omitted = removed.length - keepRemoved.length + added.length - keepAdded.length
  return { file, removed: keepRemoved, added: keepAdded, omitted, isNewFile }
}

export function hunksFor(tool: string, input: Record<string, unknown>): Hunk[] {
  const file = input.file_path
  if (typeof file !== 'string') return []
  if (tool === 'Edit' && typeof input.old_string === 'string' && typeof input.new_string === 'string') {
    return [capped(file, input.old_string.split('\n'), input.new_string.split('\n'), false)]
  }
  if (tool === 'Write' && typeof input.content === 'string') {
    return [capped(file, [], input.content.split('\n'), true)]
  }
  return []
}

export const addHunks = (agents: AgentRow[], agentId: string, hunks: Hunk[]): AgentRow[] =>
  hunks.length === 0 ? agents : patch(agents, agentId, a => ({ ...a, hunks: [...a.hunks, ...hunks].slice(-MAX_HUNKS) }))

export function diffStat(hunks: Hunk[]): { added: number; removed: number; files: number } {
  return {
    added: hunks.reduce((n, h) => n + h.added.length, 0),
    removed: hunks.reduce((n, h) => n + h.removed.length, 0),
    files: new Set(hunks.map(h => h.file)).size,
  }
}

export type Attribution = { served: string[]; tier?: string; usd?: number; isCovered: boolean; isExact: boolean }

// Slack around an agent's lifetime for the router's clock and its ledger write.
const GRACE_MS = 5_000

const isAlive = (agent: AgentRow, at: number): boolean =>
  at >= agent.startedAt - GRACE_MS && at <= (agent.endedAt ?? Infinity) + GRACE_MS

// A route belongs to an agent when it names the agent's alias inside its lifetime.
function routesOf(agent: AgentRow, routes: RouteLine[]): RouteLine[] {
  return routes.filter(r => r.alias === agent.alias && r.ts !== undefined && isAlive(agent, Date.parse(r.ts)))
}

// Another agent on the same alias was alive then: the router cannot say whose request it was.
function isShared(agents: AgentRow[], agent: AgentRow, at: number): boolean {
  return agents.some(o => o.id !== agent.id && o.alias === agent.alias && isAlive(o, at))
}

export function attribute(agents: AgentRow[], routes: RouteLine[], agentId: string): Attribution {
  const agent = agents.find(a => a.id === agentId)
  if (agent === undefined) return { served: [], tier: undefined, usd: undefined, isCovered: false, isExact: false }
  const mine = routesOf(agent, routes)
  const served = [...new Set(mine.map(r => r.served).filter((s): s is string => s !== undefined))]
  const tier = mine.find(r => r.tier !== undefined)?.tier
  const isCovered = mine.some(r => r.isCovered === true)
  if (mine.length === 0) return { served, tier, usd: undefined, isCovered, isExact: false }
  const isExact = !mine.some(r => isShared(agents, agent, Date.parse(r.ts!)))
  const isPriced = mine.every(r => r.priceUsd !== undefined)
  // Unknown is never zero: an ambiguous or unpriced agent has no cost at all.
  const usd = isExact && isPriced ? mine.reduce((n, r) => n + r.priceUsd!, 0) : undefined
  return { served, tier, usd, isCovered, isExact }
}

function coveredUsdOf(mine: RouteLine[]): number {
  return mine.reduce((n, r) => n + (r.isCovered === true ? r.priceUsd ?? 0 : 0), 0)
}

export function taskCost(agents: AgentRow[], routes: RouteLine[], ids: string[]): { usd: number; coveredUsd: number; isPartial: boolean } {
  let usd = 0
  let coveredUsd = 0
  let isPartial = false
  for (const id of ids) {
    const agent = agents.find(a => a.id === id)
    const a = attribute(agents, routes, id)
    if (a.usd === undefined) isPartial = true
    else {
      usd += a.usd
      if (agent !== undefined) coveredUsd += coveredUsdOf(routesOf(agent, routes))
    }
  }
  return { usd, coveredUsd, isPartial }
}

type Usage = { input_tokens: number; output_tokens: number; cache_read_input_tokens: number; cache_creation_input_tokens: number }

export const addUsage = (agents: AgentRow[], agentId: string, u: Usage): AgentRow[] =>
  patch(agents, agentId, a => {
    const t = a.tokens ?? { input: 0, output: 0, cacheRead: 0, cacheWrite: 0 }
    return {
      ...a,
      tokens: {
        input: t.input + u.input_tokens,
        output: t.output + u.output_tokens,
        cacheRead: t.cacheRead + u.cache_read_input_tokens,
        cacheWrite: t.cacheWrite + u.cache_creation_input_tokens,
      },
    }
  })

/** Every token an agent's requests moved: prompt (fresh, cached, written) plus output. */
export const totalTokens = (t: NonNullable<AgentRow['tokens']>): number => t.input + t.cacheRead + t.cacheWrite + t.output

import { test, expect } from 'claude-code/testing'

const TOOL = 'mcp__sonata-loop__sonata_loop'
const PANE = { component: 'Pane', props: { title: 'sonata loop', isFocused: true, bodyColumns: 100 }, requestId: 'sonata-loop' } as const

    on('ui.open', () => ({ value: { isPlaced: true } }))
    on('agent.spawn', () => ({ model: 'sonata-code-simple', agentId: 'a1' }))
    on('tool.call', { tool: 'Edit' }, () => ({ result: {}, text: 'ok' }))
    on('session.id', () => ({ value: 's1' }))
    on('http.fetch', () => ({ value: { status: 200, ok: true, headers: {}, text: '{"routes":[]}' } }))
    on('clock.sleep', () => new Promise(() => {}))
    await $.tool.call({ tool: TOOL, action: 'plan', title: 'auth', tasks: [{ id: '1', title: 'Retry queue' }] })
    await $.tool.call({ tool: TOOL, action: 'start', taskId: '1', phase: 'code' })
    await $.agent.spawn({ subagentType: 'code-simple', description: 'queue tests', prompt: 'x' } as never)
    await $.tool.call({ tool: 'Edit', agentId: 'a1', file_path: '/r/q.ts', old_string: 'retry(fn)', new_string: 'retry(fn, { backoff })' } as never)

    const ui = await $.ui.mount({ plugin: 'sonata-loop', surface, ...PANE })
    expect((await ui.find({ key: 'task:1' }))?.text).toMatch(/Retry queue/)
    expect((await ui.find({ key: 'agent:a1' }))?.text).toMatch(/code-simple/)
    expect(await ui.find({ text: /backoff/ })).toBeUndefined()
    await ui.press({ key: 'agent:a1' })
    expect(await ui.find({ text: /\+ retry\(fn, \{ backoff \}\)/ })).toBeDefined()
    await ui.press({ key: 'agent:a1' })
    expect(await ui.find({ text: /backoff/ })).toBeUndefined()
    await ui.unmount()
  })
}

test('a router error keeps the last reported models and says how old they are', async ($, on) => {
  on('ui.open', () => ({ value: { isPlaced: true } }))
  on('agent.spawn', () => ({ model: 'sonata-code-simple', agentId: 'a1' }))
  on('session.id', () => ({ value: 's1' }))
  on('session.end', () => ({ sessionId: 's' }))
  on('turn.step', async function* (_$, e) { return { ...e, answer: '', toolUses: [], stopReason: null, usage: null } })
  on('turn.complete', () => ({ text: '' }))
  let calls = 0
  on('http.fetch', () => {
    calls += 1
    if (calls > 1) throw new Error('down')
    return {
      value: {
        status: 200,
        ok: true,
        headers: {},
        text: JSON.stringify({ routes: [{ alias: 'sonata-code-simple', served: 'flash-1', status: 200, ts: new Date().toISOString(), tier: 'simple', priceUsd: 0.01 }] }),
      },
    }
  })
  let parked!: () => void
  const isParked = new Promise<void>(r => { parked = r })
  on('clock.sleep', () => { parked(); return new Promise(() => {}) })
  await $.agent.spawn({ subagentType: 'code-simple', description: 'x', prompt: 'x' } as never)
  // One step, so the row carries the alias the route line names.
  const step = $.turn.step({ turnId: 't', index: 0, model: 'sonata-code-simple', messageCount: 1, agentId: 'a1' } as never)
  for await (const _chunk of step) { /* drain */ }
  await isParked
  await $.turn.complete({ agentId: 'a1', reason: 'answer', answer: '', durationMs: 1, isAborted: false, turnId: 't' } as never)
  const ui = await $.ui.mount({ plugin: 'sonata-loop', surface: 'terminal', ...PANE })
  expect(await ui.find({ text: /showing what it reported/ })).toBeDefined()
  expect(await ui.find({ text: /flash-1/ })).toBeDefined()
  await ui.unmount()
})

    { alias: 'sonata-code-simple', ts: new Date().toISOString(), served: 'kimi-9', status: 200, priceUsd: 9, isCovered: 'yes' },

===== FILE 17 skills/loop/hooks/panel.tsx =====
import type { AgentRow, Hunk, Loop, LoopTask, RouterState, View } from '../types'
import { attribute, childrenOf, depthOf, diffStat, taskCost, totalTokens } from './model'

export type PanelData = {
  loop: Loop | null
  agents: AgentRow[]
  router: RouterState
  view: View
  now: number
  /** The pane's body width in cells. */
  cols: number
  /** The session's working directory, so diff paths read relative to it. */
  cwd?: string
}
export type PanelActions = {
  select: (key: string) => void
  toggleFold: (key: string) => void
  toggleActive: () => void
  jumpLatest: () => void
  copy: (text: string) => void
}

// sonata's departure-board vocabulary (DESIGN.md), in Claude Code's own theme
// keys so the pane follows the host's light or dark theme. `claude` is the
// terracotta accent DESIGN.md already borrows: spent on each active task's
// numeral, the selection edge and the live router stroke, nothing else.
const C = { text: 'text', muted: 'inactive', rule: 'subtle', accent: 'claude', low: 'success', mid: 'warning', high: 'error' } as const

// The board's strokes. The mark carries the state; the word and colour only repeat it.
const STROKE = { running: '━━', done: '──', queued: '· ·', condition: '─ ─' } as const

const BAR_MIN_COLS = 76 // below this the cost bar goes first
const WORD_MIN_COLS = 56 // below this the status word goes; the stroke stands alone
const MODEL_MIN_COLS = 52 // below this an agent row drops its model column
/** A running agent silent this long reads as stalled: silence is a failure mode. */
const STALL_MS = 90_000

const money = (usd: number): string => `$${usd.toFixed(usd < 1 ? 4 : 2)}`
const clock = (ms: number): string => {
  const s = Math.max(0, Math.floor(ms / 1000))
  const m = Math.floor(s / 60)
  return m >= 60 ? `${Math.floor(m / 60)}h${String(m % 60).padStart(2, '0')}` : `${m}:${String(s % 60).padStart(2, '0')}`
}
/** A token count in 5 cells at most: 812, 9.4k, 41.5k, 169k, 1.2M. */
const tok = (n: number): string =>
  n < 1000 ? String(n) : n < 100_000 ? `${(n / 1000).toFixed(1)}k` : n < 1_000_000 ? `${Math.round(n / 1000)}k` : `${(n / 1_000_000).toFixed(1)}M`
const ago = (ms: number): string => (ms < 60_000 ? `${Math.max(0, Math.round(ms / 1000))}s ago` : `${Math.round(ms / 60_000)}m ago`)
/** Cut to `n` cells, ending in `…` when cut (DESIGN.md: never truncate silently). */
const fit = (s: string, n: number): string => (n <= 0 ? '' : s.length <= n ? s : `${s.slice(0, Math.max(0, n - 1))}…`)
/** Cut from the left, for paths: the file name is the part worth keeping. */
const fitLeft = (s: string, n: number): string => (s.length <= n ? s : `…${s.slice(s.length - n + 1)}`)
const padR = (s: string, n: number): string => fit(s, n).padEnd(Math.max(0, n))
const padL = (s: string, n: number): string => fit(s, n).padStart(Math.max(0, n))

/** Every agent id in the trees rooted at `ids`, roots first. */
const treeIds = (agents: AgentRow[], ids: string[]): string[] =>
  ids.flatMap(id => [id, ...treeIds(agents, childrenOf(agents, id).map(c => c.id))])

/**
 * A task's top-level agents. `agentIds` also lists the children its agents
 * spawned, so walking trees from all of them draws and counts a child twice.
 */
const rootsOf = (t: LoopTask, agents: AgentRow[]): string[] =>
  t.agentIds.filter(id => {
    const parent = agents.find(a => a.id === id)?.parentId
    return parent === undefined || !t.agentIds.includes(parent)
  })

const lastStepAt = (a: AgentRow): number => (a.stepTimes.length > 0 ? a.stepTimes[a.stepTimes.length - 1] : a.startedAt)

type Status = { mark: string; word: string; color: string }

/**
 * A task's state. A failure or an escalation is a condition and takes the
 * status column, the one place to look for trouble. While the router cannot
 * be read, an active state is drawn unconfirmed rather than at full strength.
 */
function taskStatus(t: LoopTask, routerDown: boolean): Status {
  if (t.state === 'done') return { mark: STROKE.done, word: 'done', color: C.low }
  if (t.state === 'pending') return { mark: STROKE.queued, word: 'queued', color: C.muted }
  if (t.escalatedTo) return { mark: STROKE.condition, word: `→${t.escalatedTo}`, color: C.mid }
  if (t.failures > 0) return { mark: STROKE.condition, word: `failed ${t.failures}x`, color: C.mid }
  return { mark: STROKE.running, word: t.state, color: routerDown ? C.muted : C.text }
}

function agentStatus(a: AgentRow, now: number, routerDown: boolean): Status {
  if (a.status === 'running') {
    if (now - lastStepAt(a) > STALL_MS) return { mark: STROKE.condition, word: 'stalled', color: C.mid }
    return { mark: STROKE.running, word: 'running', color: routerDown ? C.muted : C.text }
  }
  if (a.status === 'done') return { mark: STROKE.done, word: 'done', color: C.low }
  if (a.status === 'aborted') return { mark: STROKE.condition, word: 'stopped', color: C.mid }
  return { mark: STROKE.condition, word: 'failed', color: C.high }
}

type Tokens = NonNullable<AgentRow['tokens']>
const sumTokens = (ts: Tokens[]): Tokens | undefined =>
  ts.length === 0
    ? undefined
    : ts.reduce((s, t) => ({ input: s.input + t.input, output: s.output + t.output, cacheRead: s.cacheRead + t.cacheRead, cacheWrite: s.cacheWrite + t.cacheWrite }))

/**
 * The pane's tree. Pure: `h` is the hooks module's JSX factory (a global there
 * only, so it is handed in), `els` the surface's element table and `act` the
 * press handlers the render hook built, so nothing here touches `$`.
 *
 * One line per task and per agent, on shared columns. Rows are `plain`
 * Buttons: no bracket chrome, and the surface's own focus inversion marks the
 * keyboard cursor. Selecting a row opens its detail directly beneath it.
 */
export function panelTree(h: any, els: any, data: PanelData, act: PanelActions) {
  const { Box, Text, Button } = els
  const { loop, agents, router, view, now } = data
  const width = Math.max(40, Math.min(120, data.cols))
  const inner = width - 1 // the selection edge takes the first cell
  const routerDown = router.error !== undefined

  // ── the column budget, measured once for every row ──
  const statusW = width >= WORD_MIN_COLS ? 14 : 4
  const costW = width >= BAR_MIN_COLS ? 13 : 9
  const barW = width >= BAR_MIN_COLS ? 10 : 0
  const timeW = 6
  const tokW = 7
  const idW = 4
  const typeW = 16
  const showModel = width >= MODEL_MIN_COLS
  const rule = '─'.repeat(width)
  const modelW = (indent: number) => inner - indent - typeW - tokW - timeW - costW - statusW

  const status = (s: Status) => (
    <Text color={s.color}>{padR(` ${s.mark}${statusW > 4 ? ` ${s.word}` : ''}`, statusW)}</Text>
  )

  // ── model cell: what the router actually served, or why it cannot say ──
  const modelOf = (a: AgentRow): { served: string; tier: string; color: string } => {
    const at = attribute(agents, router.routes, a.id)
    // Waiting only makes sense for a router that has answered before.
    const waiting = a.status === 'running' && !(router.error !== undefined && router.at === undefined)
    if (at.served.length === 0) return { served: waiting ? 'waiting for router' : '?', tier: '', color: C.muted }
    return { served: `${at.isExact ? '→' : '≈'} ${at.served.join('/')}`, tier: at.tier ? ` · ${at.tier}` : '', color: at.isExact ? C.muted : C.mid }
  }
  // The tier is a column: it drops for every row at once, never for one row.
  const indentOf = (a: AgentRow) => idW + 1 + 2 * depthOf(agents, a.id)
  const agentCost = (a: AgentRow): any => {
    const at = attribute(agents, router.routes, a.id)
    if (a.status === 'running' || at.usd === undefined) return <Text color={C.rule}>{padL('—', costW)}</Text>
    const suffix = width >= BAR_MIN_COLS && at.isCovered ? <Text color={C.muted}> sub</Text> : null
    return <Text color={C.muted}>{padL(money(at.usd), Math.max(0, costW - (suffix ? 4 : 0)))}{suffix}</Text>
  }
  const stripTier = agents.some(a => {
    const m = modelOf(a)
    return (m.served + m.tier).length > modelW(indentOf(a))
  })

  const selected = view.selected
  const isSel = (key: string) => selected === key
  const edge = (key: string) => <Text color={C.accent}>{isSel(key) ? '▌' : ' '}</Text>
  const relPath = (file: string) =>
    data.cwd !== undefined && file.startsWith(`${data.cwd}/`) ? file.slice(data.cwd.length + 1) : file

  // ── the detail of a selected row, drawn beneath it ──
  const detailLines = (key: string, ids: string[], label: string, indent: number): any[] => {
    const rowsOf = ids.map(id => agents.find(a => a.id === id)).filter((a): a is AgentRow => a !== undefined)
    const hunks: Hunk[] = rowsOf.flatMap(a => a.hunks)
    const stat = diffStat(hunks)
    const tokens = sumTokens(rowsOf.map(a => a.tokens).filter((t): t is Tokens => t !== undefined))
    const pad = ' '.repeat(indent + 1)
    const avail = width - indent - 1
    const cost = taskCost(agents, router.routes, ids)
    const hasBilledAndCovered = cost.coveredUsd > 0 && cost.usd > cost.coveredUsd
    return [
      ...(hasBilledAndCovered ? [<Text key={`${key}:d:cost`} color={C.muted}>{`${pad}cost   ${money(cost.usd - cost.coveredUsd)} billed · ${money(cost.coveredUsd)} sub`}</Text>] : []),
      <Text key={`${key}:d:head`}>
        <Text color={C.accent}>▌</Text>
        <Text color={C.muted}>{`${pad.slice(1)}${fit(label, Math.max(10, avail - 22))}`}</Text>
        <Text color={C.muted}>{hunks.length > 0 ? `   +${stat.added} −${stat.removed}   ${stat.files} file${stat.files === 1 ? '' : 's'}` : ''}</Text>
      </Text>,
      <Text key={`${key}:d:tok`} color={C.muted}>{
        tokens === undefined
          ? `${pad}no token usage reported yet`
          : `${pad}${fit(`in ${tok(tokens.input)}   out ${tok(tokens.output)}   cache read ${tok(tokens.cacheRead)}   cache write ${tok(tokens.cacheWrite)}`, avail)}`
      }</Text>,
      ...(rowsOf.some(a => a.usedBash) ? [<Text key={`${key}:d:bash`} color={C.mid}>{`${pad}${fit('Bash ran here too. Edits it made are not in this diff.', avail)}`}</Text>] : []),
      ...(hunks.length === 0 ? [<Text key={`${key}:d:none`} color={C.muted}>{`${pad}no applied edits yet`}</Text>] : []),
      ...hunks.flatMap((hunk, i) => [
        <Button key={`copy:${i}`} plain onPress={() => act.copy([...hunk.removed.map(l => `- ${l}`), ...hunk.added.map(l => `+ ${l}`)].join('\n'))}>
          <Text>
            <Text color={C.text} bold>{`${pad}${fitLeft(relPath(hunk.file), Math.max(10, avail - 9))}`}</Text>
            <Text color={C.muted}>{hunk.isNewFile ? '  written' : '  edited'}</Text>
          </Text>
        </Button>,
        ...hunk.removed.map((l, j) => <Text key={`hunk:${i}:-${j}`} color={C.text} backgroundColor="diffRemoved">{padR(`- ${l}`, inner)}</Text>),
        ...hunk.added.map((l, j) => <Text key={`hunk:${i}:+${j}`} color={C.text} backgroundColor="diffAdded">{padR(`+ ${l}`, inner)}</Text>),
        ...(hunk.omitted > 0 ? [<Text key={`hunk:${i}:more`} color={C.muted}>{`${pad}… ${hunk.omitted} more line${hunk.omitted === 1 ? '' : 's'}`}</Text>] : []),
      ]),
      <Box key={`${key}:d:gap`} height={1} />,
    ]
  }

  // ── agent rows: role, model, tokens, time, state; activity only while running ──
  const agentLines = (a: AgentRow): any[] => {
    const kids = childrenOf(agents, a.id)
    // A filtered-out parent still shows its running descendants.
    if (!view.showAll && a.status !== 'running') return kids.flatMap(agentLines)
    const key = `agent:${a.id}`
    const depth = depthOf(agents, a.id)
    const indent = indentOf(a)
    const pad = ' '.repeat(indent)
    const restW = modelW(indent)
    const model = modelOf(a)
    const modelText = stripTier ? model.served : model.served + model.tier
    const elapsed = clock((a.endedAt ?? now) - a.startedAt)
    const lines = [
      <Button key={key} plain onPress={() => act.select(key)}>
        <Text>
          {edge(key)}
          <Text>{pad}</Text>
          <Text color={C.text} bold={isSel(key)}>{padR(a.type, showModel ? typeW : typeW + restW)}</Text>
          {showModel ? <Text color={model.color}>{padR(modelText, restW)}</Text> : null}
          <Text color={a.tokens ? C.muted : C.rule}>{padL(a.tokens ? tok(totalTokens(a.tokens)) : '—', tokW)}</Text>
          <Text color={C.muted}>{padL(elapsed, timeW)}</Text>
          {agentCost(a)}
          {status(agentStatus(a, now, routerDown))}
        </Text>
      </Button>,
    ]
    // The one detail line on the board: what a running agent is doing, and how recently.
    if (a.status === 'running') {
      const what = a.activity ?? a.description
      const live = [what, a.steps > 0 ? `step ${a.steps}` : undefined, a.stepTimes.length > 0 ? ago(now - lastStepAt(a)) : undefined]
        .filter(Boolean).join(' · ')
      lines.push(<Text key={`${key}:doing`} color={C.muted}>{` ${pad}  ${fit(live, inner - indent - 2)}`}</Text>)
    }
    if (isSel(key)) lines.push(...detailLines(key, [a.id], `${a.type}   ${a.description}`, indent))
    // Two levels in full; deeper descendants fold onto their ancestor's line.
    if (depth >= 1 && kids.length > 0 && !view.expanded.includes(`fold:${a.id}`)) {
      const hidden = treeIds(agents, kids.map(k => k.id)).length
      lines.push(
        <Button key={`fold:${a.id}`} plain dimColor onPress={() => act.toggleFold(`fold:${a.id}`)}>
          {` ${pad}  +${hidden} more below`}
        </Button>,
      )
      return lines
    }
    for (const k of kids) lines.push(...agentLines(k))
    return lines
  }

  // ── task rows: id, title, share-of-spend bar, cost, state stroke ──
  const costs = (loop?.tasks ?? []).map(t => taskCost(agents, router.routes, treeIds(agents, rootsOf(t, agents))))
  const maxCost = Math.max(0, ...costs.map(c => c.usd))

  // A neutral bar: length compares spend; green stays reserved for done.
  const bar = (usd: number) => {
    if (barW === 0) return null
    // Nothing priced yet: an empty track would read as a measurement of zero.
    if (maxCost === 0) return <Text>{' '.repeat(barW + 1)}</Text>
    const filled = Math.round((usd / maxCost) * barW)
    return (
      <Text>
        <Text color={C.muted}>{'━'.repeat(filled)}</Text>
        <Text color={C.rule}>{'─'.repeat(barW - filled)}</Text>
        <Text> </Text>
      </Text>
    )
  }

  const taskLines = (t: LoopTask, i: number): any[] => {
    const key = `task:${t.id}`
    const roots = rootsOf(t, agents)
    const ids = treeIds(agents, roots)
    const cost = costs[i]
    const isActive = t.state !== 'done' && t.state !== 'pending'
    const titleW = inner - idW - (barW ? barW + 1 : 0) - costW - statusW
    const costText = ids.length === 0 || (cost.isPartial && cost.usd === 0)
      ? '—'
      : `${cost.isPartial ? '≈' : ''}${money(cost.usd)}`
    const costSuffix = width >= BAR_MIN_COLS && cost.coveredUsd > 0 ? <Text color={C.muted}> sub</Text> : null
    const top = roots.map(id => agents.find(a => a.id === id)).filter((a): a is AgentRow => a !== undefined)
    return [
      <Box key={`${key}:gap`} height={i === 0 ? 0 : 1} />,
      <Button key={key} plain onPress={() => act.select(key)}>
        <Text>
          {edge(key)}
          <Text color={isActive ? C.accent : C.muted} bold={isActive}>{padL(t.id === 'final' ? 'end' : t.id, idW - 1)} </Text>
          <Text color={t.state === 'pending' ? C.muted : C.text} bold={isActive || isSel(key)}>{padR(t.title, titleW)}</Text>
          {bar(cost.usd)}
          <Text color={costText === '—' ? C.rule : C.muted}>{padL(costText, Math.max(0, costW - (costSuffix ? 4 : 0)))}</Text>{costSuffix}
          {status(taskStatus(t, routerDown))}
        </Text>
      </Button>,
      ...(isSel(key) ? detailLines(key, ids, `${t.id === 'final' ? 'end' : t.id}   ${t.title}`, idW) : []),
      ...top.flatMap(agentLines),
    ]
  }

  const unplanned = agents.filter(a => a.parentId === undefined && a.taskId === undefined)
  const done = loop?.tasks.filter(t => t.state === 'done').length ?? 0
  const loopCost = costs.reduce((n, c) => n + c.usd, 0)
  const loopCovered = costs.reduce((n, c) => n + c.coveredUsd, 0)
  const loopPartial = costs.some(c => c.isPartial)
  const counted = agents.filter(a => a.tokens !== undefined)
  const loopTokens = counted.reduce((n, a) => n + totalTokens(a.tokens!), 0)
  const costNote = loop === null
    ? ''
    : loopCost === 0 && loopPartial ? 'cost unknown'
      : loopCovered > 0
        ? `${loopPartial ? '≈' : ''}${loopCost > loopCovered ? `${money(loopCost - loopCovered)} + ` : ''}${money(loopCovered)} sub`
        : `${loopPartial ? '≈' : ''}${money(loopCost)}`

  const routerLine = router.error !== undefined
    ? {
        mark: STROKE.condition,
        color: C.mid,
        text: router.at !== undefined
          ? `${router.error} · showing what it reported ${ago(now - router.at)}`
          : `${router.error} · models ?, costs unknown`,
      }
    : router.at === undefined
      ? { mark: STROKE.queued, color: C.muted, text: 'router not read yet' }
      : { mark: STROKE.done, color: C.accent, text: `router up · updated ${ago(now - router.at)}` }

  // The head: the title, then the loop's facts right-aligned on the same line.
  const tokNote = counted.length === 0 ? '' : `${tok(loopTokens)} tok   `
  const facts = loop === null ? 'idle' : `${done} of ${loop.tasks.length} done   ${tokNote}${costNote}   ${clock(now - loop.startedAt)}`
  const title = loop === null ? '' : loop.title
  const titleRoom = Math.max(0, width - 6 - facts.length - 3)

  return (
    <Box flexDirection="column">
      <Text>
        <Text color={C.text} bold>Loop</Text>
        <Text color={C.text}>{`  ${padR(title, titleRoom)}`}</Text>
        <Text color={C.muted}>{padL(facts, width - 6 - titleRoom)}</Text>
      </Text>
      <Text color={C.rule}>{rule}</Text>

      {loop === null && unplanned.length === 0 && (
        <Box flexDirection="column" marginTop={1}>
          <Text color={C.mid}>No loop running.</Text>
          <Text color={C.muted}>{fit('Run /sonata-loop <feature> to see it here.', width)}</Text>
        </Box>
      )}

      {loop !== null && <Box height={1} />}
      {loop?.tasks.flatMap(taskLines)}

      {unplanned.length > 0 && (
        <Box flexDirection="column" marginTop={1}>
          <Text color={C.muted}>{'     unplanned'}</Text>
          {unplanned.flatMap(agentLines)}
        </Box>
      )}

      {loop?.isDone && loop.summary !== undefined && (
        <Box marginTop={1}><Text color={C.muted}>{fit(`     ${loop.summary}`, width)}</Text></Box>
      )}

      <Box marginTop={1}><Text color={C.rule}>{rule}</Text></Box>
      <Text>
        <Text color={routerLine.color}>{`${routerLine.mark} `}</Text>
        <Text color={C.muted}>{fit(routerLine.text, width - 4)}</Text>
      </Text>
      {(loop !== null || agents.length > 0) && <Box flexDirection="row">
        <Button key="toggle:active" plain dimColor hotkey="a" onPress={() => act.toggleActive()}>
          {view.showAll ? 'active only' : 'all agents'}
        </Button>
        <Text>{'   '}</Text>
        <Button key="jump:latest" plain dimColor hotkey="l" onPress={() => act.jumpLatest()}>latest</Button>
        {width >= 60 && <Text color={C.muted}>{'   enter: detail'}</Text>}
        {width >= 80 && <Text color={C.muted}>{'   ctrl+x tab: focus'}</Text>}
      </Box>}
    </Box>
  )
}
===== FILE 18 skills/loop/hooks/poll.test.ts =====
import { test, expect } from 'claude-code/testing'

// The poll is started with `void poll($)`. A sleep the engine rejects (a test
// torn down, a plugin reloaded mid-sleep) must stop the poll quietly, never
// escape as an unhandled rejection.
test('a rejected sleep stops the poll without an unhandled rejection', async ($, on) => {
  let slept = 0
  on('ui.open', () => ({ value: { isPlaced: true } }))
  on('agent.spawn', () => ({ model: 'sonata-code-simple', agentId: 'a1' }))
  on('session.id', () => ({ value: 's1' }))
  on('http.fetch', () => ({ value: { status: 200, ok: true, headers: {}, text: '{"routes":[]}' } }))
  on('clock.sleep', () => { slept++; return Promise.reject(new Error('environment gone')) })
  await $.agent.spawn({ subagentType: 'code-simple', description: 'x', prompt: 'x' } as never)
  for (let i = 0; i < 20 && slept === 0; i++) await Promise.resolve()
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 20))
  expect(slept).toBeGreaterThan(0)
})
